import json

def main():
    distances = build_distances()

    people = [
        {"name": "Stephanie", "location": "Fisherman's Wharf", "start": parse_time_24("15:30"), "end": parse_time_24("22:00"), "min_dur": 30},
        {"name": "Lisa", "location": "Financial District", "start": parse_time_24("10:45"), "end": parse_time_24("17:15"), "min_dur": 15},
        {"name": "Melissa", "location": "Russian Hill", "start": parse_time_24("17:00"), "end": parse_time_24("21:45"), "min_dur": 120},
        {"name": "Betty", "location": "Marina District", "start": parse_time_24("10:45"), "end": parse_time_24("14:15"), "min_dur": 60},
        {"name": "Sarah", "location": "Richmond District", "start": parse_time_24("16:15"), "end": parse_time_24("19:30"), "min_dur": 105},
        {"name": "Daniel", "location": "Pacific Heights", "start": parse_time_24("18:30"), "end": parse_time_24("21:45"), "min_dur": 60},
        {"name": "Joshua", "location": "Haight-Ashbury", "start": parse_time_24("9:00"), "end": parse_time_24("15:30"), "min_dur": 15},
        {"name": "Joseph", "location": "Presidio", "start": parse_time_24("7:00"), "end": parse_time_24("13:00"), "min_dur": 45},
        {"name": "Andrew", "location": "Nob Hill", "start": parse_time_24("19:45"), "end": parse_time_24("22:00"), "min_dur": 105},
        {"name": "John", "location": "The Castro", "start": parse_time_24("13:15"), "end": parse_time_24("19:45"), "min_dur": 45},
    ]

    index_map = {p["name"]: i for i, p in enumerate(people)}
    n = len(people)

    start_location = "Embarcadero"
    start_time = parse_time_24("9:00")

    def travel(a, b):
        if a == b:
            return 0
        return distances[(a, b)]

    best = {
        "count": 0,
        "total_meet_minutes": 0,
        "finish_time": start_time,
        "itinerary": []
    }

    # Pruning helpers
    visited_earliest = {}  # (loc, met_mask) -> earliest time reached

    # Candidates ordering heuristic: earliest window end first
    order_indices = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: people[i]["end"])

    def dfs(curr_loc, curr_time, met_mask, itinerary, total_meet_minutes):
        nonlocal best

        curr_count = bin(met_mask).count("1")

        # Update best if improved
        def better(a, b):
            # a and b are dicts with keys count, total_meet_minutes, finish_time
            if a["count"] != b["count"]:
                return a["count"] > b["count"]
            if a["total_meet_minutes"] != b["total_meet_minutes"]:
                return a["total_meet_minutes"] > b["total_meet_minutes"]
            return a["finish_time"] < b["finish_time"]

        candidate_best = {
            "count": curr_count,
            "total_meet_minutes": total_meet_minutes,
            "finish_time": curr_time,
            "itinerary": itinerary
        }
        if better(candidate_best, best):
            best = candidate_best

        # Upper bound on remaining possible meetings: those whose window hasn't closed yet
        remaining_possible = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if not (met_mask & (1 << i)):
                if people[i]["end"] >= curr_time:
                    remaining_possible += 1

        if curr_count + remaining_possible <= best["count"]:
            return

        # Prune dominated states: if we've reached same (loc, met) earlier, current is worse
        key = (curr_loc, met_mask)
        prev_time = visited_earliest.get(key)
        if prev_time is not None and prev_time <= curr_time:
            return
        visited_earliest[key] = curr_time

        # Try next meetings
        for i in order_indices:
            if met_mask & (1 << i):
                continue
            p = people[i]
            t_travel = travel(curr_loc, p["location"])
            arrival = curr_time + t_travel
            # if even arriving and doing min duration exceeds window end, skip
            earliest_start = max(arrival, p["start"])
            end_time = earliest_start + p["min_dur"]
            if end_time > p["end"]:
                continue

            new_it = itinerary + [{
                "action": "meet",
                "location": p["location"],
                "person": p["name"],
                "start_time": fmt_time(earliest_start),
                "end_time": fmt_time(end_time),
                "_start_min": earliest_start,
                "_end_min": end_time
            }]

            dfs(p["location"], end_time, met_mask | (1 << i), new_it, total_meet_minutes + p["min_dur"])

    dfs(start_location, start_time, 0, [], 0)

    # Clean itinerary for output (remove helper fields)
    output_itinerary = []
    for item in best["itinerary"]:
        output_itinerary.append({
            "action": item["action"],
            "location": item["location"],
            "person": item["person"],
            "start_time": item["start_time"],
            "end_time": item["end_time"]
        })

    result = {"itinerary": output_itinerary}
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))  # JSON only

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
